name: Sundersteel Surge
description: Surge forward on a heavy pace and cut as the feet land so the edge arrives with the whole body behind it.

name: Sundersteel Parry
description: Turn a blow aside on a weighted edge and cut back along the line it opened.

name: Sundersteel Bind
description: Press the target's blade down with a dense thread of qi and hold it from the guard.

name: Sundersteel Sense
description: Read the weight and temper of the target's weapon through the blade and find where it will break.

name: Sundersteel Rend
description: Cut with the sundering weight so the edge rends guard and body in one great stroke.

name: Sundersteel Aegis
description: Hold a thick shell of dense qi about the wielder that stands against an enormous blow.

name: Sundersteel Lance
description: Gather qi to the point and loose a sundering lance that pierces what a plain thrust cannot.

name: Sundersteel Sweep
description: Swing the loaded blade in a full circle that cuts every foe within the reach of the stroke.

name: Sundersteel Apex
description: Cut with the whole weight of the school so the stroke lands and presses down the target's qi.

name: Sundersteel Flash
description: Flash across the target's reach in a blur of steel and strike as the heavy edge arrives.

name: Sundersteel Reprisal
description: Take the full blow on the sundering edge and send the same force back through the striker.

name: Sunderfall Edge
description: The school's great form: the whole sundering weight falls on the edge in one cut whose force grows with the wielder's skill.

name: Ruinfall Edge
description: Cut one ruinous stroke that destroys all within its swath out to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier.

name: Worldsteel Surge
description: Surge on a pace that seems to cover more ground than the body can and cut at its end.

name: Worldsteel Parry
description: Turn a heavy blow off the edge and answer with a cut that carries the weight of the formed Core.

name: Worldsteel Hold
description: Pin the target's weapon with a heavy thread of core qi and bear it to the ground.

name: Worldsteel Mark
description: Spread a net of core qi along the blade and read the weight and wounds of every foe in it.

name: Worldsteel Rend
description: Cut with the weight of the formed Core so the edge rends guard and body in a long stroke.

name: Worldsteel Aegis
description: Stand on the Core's strength and hold a thick shell of qi against a heavy assault.

name: Worldsteel Lance
description: Gather core qi to the point and loose a lance of steel that pierces through armor and stone.

name: Worldsteel Sweep
description: Swing the blade in a wide ring that cuts every foe the stroke can reach.

name: Worldsteel Apex
description: Cut so that the stroke lands and seals the target's qi along the wound.

name: Worldsteel Passage
description: Pass the blade through the target's guard as if it were smoke and cut from within it.

name: Worldsteel Reprisal
description: Take a great blow on the Core-backed edge and return its full force along the line it came.

name: Worldsteel Verdict
description: The school's great form: one stroke of judgment whose weight and reach rise with the wielder's skill.

name: Worldsplitting Edge
description: Draw one stroke that splits all in its path out to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier.

name: Cataclysm Edge
description: Loose a final cut that ruins everything within the ceiling of the wielder's tier and bows the qi of the survivors.

name: Godsteel Surge
description: Surge on divine qi and cut before the pace ends so the edge arrives with a god's weight.

name: Godsteel Parry
description: Turn a vast blow aside on the edge and answer along the line it opened.

name: Godsteel Bind
description: Hold the target's weapon in a thread of divine qi that no hand can strain against.

name: Godsteel Sense
description: Open the divine blade to every living thing within its reach and read their weapons and wounds.

name: Godsteel Rend
description: Cut with divine weight so the edge rends guard and body in a single mighty stroke.

name: Godsteel Aegis
description: Hold a divine shell about the wielder and allies that stands against the heaviest assault.

name: Godsteel Lance
description: Gather divine qi to the point and loose a lance that pierces the target and what stands behind.

name: Godsteel Sweep
description: Swing the divine blade in a full ring that cuts every foe the stroke can reach.

name: Godsteel Apex
description: Cut with divine force so the stroke lands and presses down the target's qi.

name: Godsteel Passage
description: Pass the divine blade through the guard as though it were not there and cut from beyond.

name: Godsteel Reprisal
description: Take a vast blow on the divine edge and send its force back through the striker.

name: Godsteel Dominion
description: The school's great form: the divine edge rules all it cuts and its reach and weight rise with skill.

name: Godsteel Verdict
description: The school's second great form: one divine stroke of judgment whose weight rises with the wielder's skill.

name: Heaven Parting Edge
description: Part everything in the stroke's path out to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's divine tier.

name: Last Light Edge
description: Loose a last bright cut that ends all it touches up to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier.
